verdict.rationale: Fathom publishes a per-endpoint API reference covering recordings, transcripts, summaries, downloads, webhooks and users, plus a quickstart for making a first call. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (no try-it console or playground) or that its examples can be run in place. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, which would normally back such tooling. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console, runnable in-reference examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
